name: aggravation
description: A sense that more negatives are being added to already negative situation.
perceptions: Now something happened to make things worse.
examples: You get the flu while having a broken arm.
You're already late for an important appointment and get a flat tire.
You break your favorite mug slamming it on the counter in anger.

guidance.description: See guidance for anger or frustration.

commentaries.quote: If you have a job without any aggravations, you don't have a job.
The effect of power and publicity on all men is the aggravation of self, a sort of tumor that ends by killing the victim's sympathies.
A vacation trip is one-third pleasure, fondly remembered, and two-thirds aggravation, entirely forgotten.
